title: every website page carries search questions, stamped and checked like the page itself

stages.title: the stamp and the check
stages.summary: Records in every entry of `questions.json` the feature it was written from and that feature's hash, and adds the `questions` part of `bun nv site --check` with the tool a session uses to write questions.

stages.title: the Core reference
stages.summary: Writes the questions for every Core class and method page.

stages.title: configuration and CLI
stages.summary: Writes the questions for every configuration block and key, and every CLI page.

stages.title: the handwritten pages
stages.summary: Writes the questions for every page under Guides, Syntax, In depth and Install, and the front page.

stages.title: owed fails, and the second measurement
stages.summary: Makes an owed page fail `--check questions`, and measures the search again on a new blind query set across every area.

checks.name: site questions: the entry shape, stale, broken and owed, the stamp and the wrap gate
site --questions --status: no Core page owes questions
site --questions --status: no configuration or CLI page owes questions
site --questions --status: no handwritten page owes questions
site --check questions: no page is owed, stale or broken
